A '''cookbook''' was written and published by [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Handree Braman]], the owner of the [[CardSafe]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained his famous [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bat]] recipe.
